answer: Tie every new identity to a sponsor who posts a bond, like a ship tethered at a wharf before it may unload. If the newcomer misbehaves, the sponsor's stake is slashed, so mass invitation becomes a downward spiral of forfeited collateral rather than free growth. Each referral edge is a visible pigment staining the inviter's record — attackers cannot hide a sybil ring because the colored trail of sponsorship leads straight back to them.
